name: Huaraz
blurb: Online conversations regarding Huaraz currently maintain a quiet baseline with no active growth. Users frequently discuss the city as a gateway for Andean trekking and mountain exploration near Huascarán National Park.

positive: Great views of the Cordillera mountain range
Gateway to nearby glacial lakes and hiking trails
Appreciated local museums and street food history
negative: Severe flood risks from melting glacial lakes
Food quality criticized compared to Lima
Hostels book up quickly during peak trekking season

quotes.text: Huaraz hostels range from €8 party spots to €25 mountain lodges with killer Cordillera views. The best ones book up fast during trekking season (May-September), especially places near the Santa Cruz trailhead. #BackpackingPeru #HuarazHostels #AndeanTrekking
Food in Lima is much, much, better than it is in Huaraz.

39/🪦 Up to 5.000 people perished in 1941.
 ℹ️ Today Huaraz is home to 6.5x as many people as in 1941. Lake Palcacocha has 34x the volume that it did in 1990. 
In case of a GLOF, the population would have 15 to 20mins to evacuate the exposed zone.
